# WanaKana 5.3.1

`WanaKana.mjs` is the upstream ESM distribution from the npm package `wanakana@5.3.1`, with a provenance comment added and the absent source-map reference removed. QML uses only the pure conversion functions; browser binding helpers are never called.

- Upstream: https://github.com/WaniKani/WanaKana
- Commit: 77b46c2c688824904760e409853041dac2cf615d
- Tarball: https://registry.npmjs.org/wanakana/-/wanakana-5.3.1.tgz
- SHA-512 (base64): `OSDqupzTlzl2LGyqTdhcXcl6ezMiFhcUwLBP8YKaBIbMYW1wAwDvupw2T9G9oVaKT9RmaSpyTXjxddFPUcFFIw==`
- MIT license and copyright notice: WanaKana.LICENSE

No npm, CDN, or build step is needed to run the plugin.
